title: Lesson 1 Quiz: What Financial Fitness Really Means

questions.text: Which statement best describes wealth as defined in the lesson?
options: The money that comes in each month
The total amount of your debts
What you keep and build over time
The amount saved in a checking account
questions.explanation: Wealth is described as what you keep and build over time.

questions.text: True or false: The 'keep' pillar refers to earning more money.
questions.explanation: Keep means managing what you earn, not earning more.
